places.name: Kansas
places.note: Left in charge, Dish brings Lorena meals and keeps sleepless watch by her tent under the starry sky as the herd eases north.
places.location_hint: plains north of the Arkansas River, west of Dodge City

places.name: Plum creek north of the Arkansas
places.note: Small creek lined with scraggly bushes; Po gives Lorena wild plums and says its cold green water is snowmelt.
places.location_hint: on the Kansas plains about a day's drive north of the Arkansas River crossing, west of Dodge City; flows from mountains to the west

places.name: Rocky Mountains
places.note: Po points west to unseen mountains as the source of the creek's snow water.
places.location_hint: far to the west of the herd, out of sight

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Dish recalls his drunken afternoon there; Lippy remembers watching Lorena descend the stairs at the Dry Bean and Gus's card-cut wager.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Montana
places.note: Dish daydreams about what might happen with Lorena once they reach it.

groups.label: Hat Creek herd under Dish
groups.hint: bedded on the plains about a day's drive north of the Arkansas River, past a small plum creek, west of Dodge City
